primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired binary analysis (C vs A) implemented by paired_binary_analysis_v1. Outcome: deterministic verifier pass/fail per condition. Test: McNemar-style paired-proportion comparison (exact two-sided p-value) with bootstrap (10,000 resamples) for 95% confidence intervals. Report absolute percentage-point difference (guarded minus baseline), odds ratio, exact two-sided p-value, and 95% bootstrap CI. Missing/incomplete pairs treated per preregistration primary policy: complete_pair_primary (exclude incomplete pairs).
secondary_analyses: Paired contrast B vs A (constrained vs baseline) using same paired_binary_analysis_v1 procedure; Bonferroni-adjusted α per preregistration.
Paired contrast C vs B (guarded vs constrained) using same paired_binary_analysis_v1 procedure; Bonferroni-adjusted α per preregistration.
Descriptive estimator: median and IQR of revision iterations in condition C (reported as secondary estimand median_revision_iterations_condition_C).
sensitivity_analyses: Failed-call sensitivity: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat failed/missing guarded outputs as failures=0 and recompute primary estimand).
Report sensitivity to exclusion counts by reintroducing excluded items where feasible via documented reduced-invariant mappings (exploratory; counts and deterministic transformations published).
uncertainty_quantification: Bootstrap 10,000 resamples for 95% CIs on paired difference and odds ratio; exact two-sided p-values for paired test; report numerator/denominator counts, discordant-pair counts, and bootstrap distribution diagnostics. Analysis-side PRNG seeds and resample hashes published.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory test: single primary contrast (C vs A) at α=0.05 two-sided. Two secondary confirmatory contrasts (B vs A and C vs B) corrected via Bonferroni (each α=0.025 two-sided) as preregistered. All other analyses labeled exploratory.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: enforce session isolation per model call; run deterministic unit-tests for mapping/verifier before batch; apply rule-based ambiguity detection prior to model calls and exclude ambiguous intents from confirmatory set; log and report parse_failure and unsupported-feature exclusions. Produce counts and deterministic reason codes (ambiguous, parse_failure, unsupported_feature). Confirmatory analysis uses only items that pass parser, ambiguity, and verifier-coverage checks; all flagged/excluded items and hashes published.
table_specifications: Table 1: Confirmatory 2x2 paired contingency (baseline vs guarded): counts (both pass, baseline-only, guarded-only, both fail), percent success per condition, discordant-pair counts, absolute percentage-point difference, odds ratio, exact two-sided p-value, 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl; result schema paired_binary_episode_v1.
Table 2: Secondary contrasts (B vs A, C vs B): counts, differences, Bonferroni-adjusted p-values, and 95% bootstrap CIs. Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Table 3: Exclusions and contamination audit: counts and deterministic reason codes (ambiguous, parse_failure, unsupported_feature), per-exclusion hashes and brief deterministic explanation. Source: execution/execution_log.jsonl and task_manifest.jsonl.

Table 4 (supplementary machine-readable): Per-task excerpt (intent ID, topology seed, shared initial candidate hash, baseline verifier verdict, guarded repair call presence, final verdict, model_call_ids, artifact hashes). Full raw_results.jsonl published alongside manuscript.
figure_specifications: Figure 1: Bar chart of semantic-success rates by condition (baseline, constrained if available, guarded) with 95% bootstrap CIs (10,000 resamples). Data from execution/raw_results.jsonl.
Figure 2: Distribution (boxplot + jitter) of revision iterations for guarded episodes (condition C); report median and IQR. Data from paired_binary_episode_v1 revision-iteration field.

Figure 3: Flow diagram (programmatic) of episode semantics under shared_initial_candidate: initial generation → verifier pass/fail → optional single guarded repair call → final verifier verdict. Constructed from transformation_manifest.json and execution/execution_log.jsonl.
